parole.significato: Of or relating to the Pahlavi script or to Middle Persian rendered in Book Pahlavi.
parole.testo: From Iranian Persian پَهْلَوی (pahlavi), from Classical Persian پَهْلَوِی (pahlawī, “Parthian, of or relating to the age of the Iranian heroes before Islam”), from پَهْلَو (pahlaw) + ـِی (-ī).

parole.significato: An Iranian pastry with a triangular shape, similar to the South Asian samosa.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Iranian Persian سَمْبوسِه (sambuse), from Classical Persian سَنْبوسَه (sanbōsa), from Middle Persian *sambōsag. Doublet of sambusa, sambusak, sambuusa, samosa, and samsa.
